description: This file defines the `GeoPlacesClient` class, a client for interacting with the Amazon Location Service Places V2 using the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various geolocation-related operations such as autocomplete, geocode, getPlace, reverseGeocode, searchNearby, searchText, and suggest, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: GeoPlacesClient
classes.description: A specialized client class for interacting with the Amazon Location Service Places V2, extending the generic AwsClient class.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Method to perform autocomplete suggestions based on input.

methods.name: geocode
methods.description: Method to convert an address or place name into geographic coordinates.

methods.name: getPlace
methods.description: Method to retrieve details about a specific place.

methods.name: reverseGeocode
methods.description: Method to get address details from geographic coordinates.

methods.name: searchNearby
methods.description: Method to search for places near a geographic location.

methods.name: searchText
methods.description: Method to search places based on text query.

methods.name: suggest
methods.description: Method to get suggestions based on partial input.
